hunks.baseline: After closing the door and leaving the boatman alone, Mungyeong thought to himself,
hunks.sol: Mungyeong closed the door, leaving the boatman alone, and thought,

hunks.baseline: *This should be enough.*
hunks.sol: *That should be enough.*

hunks.baseline: Perhaps because he had lived a long life, the boatman was far more perceptive than Mungyeong had expected.
hunks.sol: Perhaps because he had lived so long, the boatman was far quicker on the uptake than Mungyeong had expected.

hunks.baseline: Although he would have to live under the authorities’ watch, that was still a hundred times better than being found dead somewhere without anyone knowing what had happened.
hunks.sol: He would have to spend the rest of his life under the authorities’ watch, but that was still a hundred times better than turning up dead without anyone knowing how.

hunks.baseline: His deal with the City Lord of Hubei Province was already settled. As long as the boatman kept his mouth shut, he could spend the rest of his life in peace.
hunks.sol: The deal with the City Lord of Hubei Province had already been struck. As long as the boatman kept his mouth shut, he could live out the remainder of his days in peace.

hunks.baseline: *No. Even if he tried to tell anyone, they’d obviously just treat him like a crazy old man.*
hunks.sol: Besides, even if he did talk, everyone would dismiss him as a senile old madman.

hunks.baseline: *And he won’t have to worry about money anymore. This should be a fairly decent arrangement for him.*
hunks.sol: *And he won’t have to worry about money anymore. All things considered, it’s not a bad arrangement for him.*

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong suddenly wondered what expression the boatman would make when he found the money pouch left beside the brazier.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong wondered what expression the boatman would make when he discovered the money pouch beside the brazier—and how he would react to the message from the person who had asked Mungyeong to deliver it.

hunks.baseline: And when he heard the words of the person who had handed it over and asked Mungyeong to deliver it.

hunks.baseline: *Still, he followed us for no reason and nearly died. He deserves hazard pay and workers’ compensation.*
hunks.sol: *He came along for no good reason and nearly died. The least we can do is give him hazard pay and workers’ compensation.*

hunks.baseline: A boy so young he was practically yellow instead of merely green. And a boy who never stopped surprising him.
hunks.sol: A brat so young he was practically yellow instead of merely green—and one who never stopped surprising him.

hunks.baseline: He remembered how Jin Taekyung had rampaged even more wildly instead of shrinking back in the presence of that enormous monster, unlike anything Mungyeong had ever seen or heard of. His brow furrowed.
hunks.sol: He recalled how Jin Taekyung had not shrunk back before that enormous, unprecedented monster. If anything, he had rampaged even more wildly. Mungyeong’s brow furrowed.

hunks.baseline: *Natural courage? That may be part of it, but there was something else… Yes. He looked used to it. Like a battle-hardened veteran who had fought countless battles.*
hunks.sol: *Natural courage? Perhaps. But there was something else… Yes. He looked accustomed to it. Like a battle-hardened veteran who had survived countless battles.*

hunks.baseline: Had Jin Taekyung become accustomed to strange beings called supernatural powers while fighting Dark Heaven?
hunks.sol: Had fighting Dark Heaven made Jin Taekyung accustomed to the bizarre phenomena known as supernatural powers?

hunks.baseline: Or was there some secret about Jin Taekyung that no one knew?
hunks.sol: Or did Jin Taekyung possess some secret no one else knew?

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong was lost in thought as he continued walking when he heard voices.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong was walking along, lost in thought, when voices reached him.

hunks.baseline: “Physician Song. I heard those bastards who deserve to be beaten to death were captured.”
hunks.sol: “Physician Song, I heard they caught those bastards who deserve to die.”

hunks.baseline: “Good heavens, ‘bastards who deserve to be beaten to death’? Hyang, you’re a medical apprentice. How can you use such harsh language…?”
hunks.sol: “Good heavens. ‘Bastards who deserve to die’? Hyang, you’re a medical apprentice. How can you use such harsh language…?”

hunks.baseline: In the courtyard of the clinic, where people came and went, a middle-aged medical apprentice of respectable age scolded a young female medical apprentice who did not even look old enough to be twenty. She pouted.
hunks.sol: In the busy courtyard of the clinic, an older, middle-aged medical apprentice was scolding a young female medical apprentice who did not even look twenty. She pouted.

hunks.baseline: “You’re saying that because of that gentleman, aren’t you? What does it matter? He’s too far away to hear us anyway.”
hunks.sol: “You’re only saying that because of that gentleman, aren’t you? What does it matter? He’s too far away to hear us anyway.”

hunks.baseline: Of course, unlike the young woman’s carefree assumption, Mungyeong was taking in every sound and movement around him without missing a thing.
hunks.sol: Contrary to the young woman’s carefree assumption, Mungyeong heard and saw everything happening around him without missing a thing.

hunks.baseline: The conversation between the two of them was no different.
hunks.sol: That included their conversation.

hunks.baseline: “What are you talking about?”
hunks.sol: “About what?”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, come on. Don’t pretend you don’t know. What else could I mean besides the dark-path figures of Murim who committed those heinous crimes at Dark Heaven’s instigation?”
hunks.sol: “Oh, come on. Don’t pretend you don’t know. What else could I mean but the dark-path figures of Murim who committed those heinous crimes at Dark Heaven’s instigation?”

hunks.baseline: “What could a mere medical apprentice like me possibly say? Still, I’m simply grateful that the culprits have finally been captured, and I intend to focus on my duties.”
hunks.sol: “What could a mere medical apprentice like me possibly say? I’m simply grateful the culprits have finally been captured. All I can do is devote myself to my duties.”

hunks.baseline: “But isn’t it strange? The Sea Serpent Society ship that sank at Red Cliffs, the tragedy at Dongting Lake, and even the deaths connected to the river bandits beyond Tianling Falls. They’re saying all of it was done by those men.”
hunks.sol: “But don’t you think it’s strange? The Sea Serpent Society’s ship sinking at Red Cliffs, the tragedy at Dongting Lake, even all the deaths involving the river bandits beyond Tianling Falls… They’re saying those men were responsible for everything.”

hunks.baseline: “Strange? What do you mean?”
hunks.sol: “Strange? In what way?”

hunks.baseline: “You mean the Medical Apprentice Hwang I know?”
hunks.sol: “You mean Medical Apprentice Hwang?”

hunks.baseline: The young medical apprentice broke off and turned to look around. Then she rose onto her toes and whispered.
hunks.sol: The young medical apprentice trailed off and glanced around. Then she rose onto her toes and whispered.

hunks.baseline: “She said the patient she’s looking after is a pretty famous wandering martial artist, and when he heard the story, he snorted. He said that no matter how many dark-path figures there were, there was no way they could have been a match for the Yangtze One Saber.”
hunks.sol: “She said the patient she’s looking after is a pretty famous wandering martial artist, and when he heard the story, he snorted. He said that no matter how many dark-path figures there were, they’d never be a match for the Yangtze One Saber.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s the name—or rather, the sobriquet—of the river bandit chief who suffered a disaster this time. Apparently, his martial arts are so powerful that there isn’t a martial artist anywhere who hasn’t heard of him.”
hunks.sol: “That’s the name—or rather, the sobriquet—of the river bandit chief who was killed this time. Apparently, his martial arts were so formidable that every martial artist in Murim had heard of him.”

hunks.baseline: “According to what the wandering martial artist said, the authorities rounded up so many dark-path figures this time to cover something up.”
hunks.sol: “According to the wandering martial artist, the authorities rounded up all those dark-path figures to cover something up.”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong let out a quiet laugh inwardly, while the middle-aged medical apprentice’s face stiffened.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong gave a silent, derisive laugh. The middle-aged medical apprentice’s face stiffened.

hunks.baseline: “Hyang, have you told anyone else this story?”
hunks.sol: “Hyang, have you told anyone else about this?”

hunks.baseline: “No. I was listening to it just now when Physician Song called for me, so I came straight here.”
hunks.sol: “No. I’d only just heard it when Physician Song called for me, so I came straight here.”

hunks.baseline: “What about Medical Apprentice Hwang? Did anyone else hear it besides you?”
hunks.sol: “What about Medical Apprentice Hwang? Did anyone besides you hear her?”

hunks.baseline: The genial-looking middle-aged medical apprentice’s face hardened as he questioned her. The young woman replied in a tiny voice,
hunks.sol: The genial-looking medical apprentice’s face hardened as he questioned her. The young woman replied in a tiny voice.

hunks.baseline: “No one else was there—it was just the two of us. And I was the first person Sister Hwang told.”
hunks.sol: “No one else was there. It was just the two of us. And I was the first person Sister Hwang told.”

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged medical apprentice gently patted the young woman’s head as she shrank in on herself, then continued kindly.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged medical apprentice gently patted the cowed young woman on the head and continued in a kindly voice.

hunks.baseline: “Those dark-path mongrels who committed such heinous crimes will be put to death at noon tomorrow—some beheaded, others torn apart by chariots. Their severed limbs will be rolling through the streets of Wuhan, and the ground will be soaked in blood.”
hunks.sol: “Those dark-path mongrels who committed such heinous crimes will be executed at noon tomorrow—some by beheading, others by being torn apart by chariots. Their severed limbs will roll through the streets of Wuhan, and the ground will run red with blood.”

hunks.baseline: “This is all thanks to the City Lord, who acted on the orders of His Imperial Majesty the Emperor, and to Great Hero Jin Taekyung of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, who personally exterminated the culprits. So don’t let yourself be swayed by rumors. Praise those noble men instead.”
hunks.sol: “This is all thanks to the City Lord, who acted on the orders of His Majesty the Emperor, and to Great Hero Jin Taekyung of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, who personally exterminated the culprits. So don’t be swayed by false rumors. All you need to do is praise them.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes, yes.”
hunks.sol: “Y-yes.”

hunks.baseline: “L-long live His Imperial Majesty the Emperor…”
hunks.sol: “M-may His Majesty the Emperor live ten thousand years…”

hunks.baseline: If even a medical apprentice who could be considered educated acted like this, then the reaction of ordinary people was obvious.
hunks.sol: If even an educated man like him reacted this way, there was no need to wonder how ordinary people would respond.

hunks.baseline: The world truly never changed.
hunks.sol: The world never changed.

hunks.baseline: After leaving the clinic entirely—it was part of the vast Hubei provincial government compound—he headed straight for a large estate among the many pavilions, one reserved for honored guests.
hunks.sol: After leaving the clinic, which stood within the vast Hubei provincial government compound, he headed straight for a large estate among the many pavilions, one reserved for honored guests.

hunks.baseline: And there, he found a master and Disciple proudly displaying the depth of their affection for each other.
hunks.sol: There, he found a master and Disciple proudly displaying the depth of their affection for each other.

hunks.baseline: “Say that again. What? Jeok Cheongang? Shitting?”
hunks.sol: “Say that again. What was that? ‘Jeok Cheongang’? ‘Take a shit’?”

hunks.sol: “Dormammu, I’ve come to take a shit. Ah, sorry. It slipped out on instinct.”

hunks.baseline: Watching the fierce chase unfold, Mungyeong suddenly thought,
hunks.sol: As he watched the fierce chase unfold, a thought occurred to Mungyeong.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, wait a second. That hit bone…”
hunks.sol: “Ah, wait. That hit bone…”

hunks.baseline: *Damn it. Isn’t using Flame Divine Palm going too far?*
hunks.sol: *Goddamn it. Isn’t using Flame Divine Palm going too far?*

hunks.baseline: I didn’t need gukbap.[^1] One bowl of Flame Divine Palm, and my stomach felt stuffed to the brim.
hunks.sol: Who needed gukbap?[^1] One bowl of Flame Divine Palm, and I already felt full.

hunks.baseline: As I groaned while clutching my chest, Jeok Cheongang spoke in a sinister voice.
hunks.sol: As I groaned and clutched my chest, Jeok Cheongang spoke in a sinister voice.

hunks.baseline: “It’s still far from over. How dare you speak so casually to a master as high as the heavens…”
hunks.sol: “It’s nowhere near over. How dare you speak so casually to a master as high as the heavens…”

hunks.baseline: “Ahem. Not merely a master as high as the heavens, but this old man, who is even higher than the heavens. Do you think I raised you so I could be treated like this?”
hunks.sol: “Ahem. Not merely a master as high as the heavens, but this old man, who stands even higher than the heavens. Do you think I raised you to be treated like this?”

hunks.baseline: Just as Jeok Cheongang lit both his eyes like candles, a lifeline descended from heaven.
hunks.sol: Just as Jeok Cheongang’s eyes began blazing, a lifeline descended from heaven.

hunks.baseline: “If you came in, you should have quietly watched. Why did you have to interfere?”
hunks.sol: “If you came in, you should have quietly watched. Why interfere?”

hunks.baseline: *Damn. He’s got so much charisma. No wonder his targets ended up in the grave when he was an assassin.*
hunks.sol: *Damn. He’s got so much charisma. No wonder all his targets ended up dead when he was an assassin.*

hunks.baseline: I looked at Mungyeong with eyes overflowing with emotion.
hunks.sol: I gazed at Mungyeong with emotion welling in my eyes.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang ominously rolled up his sleeve, but Mungyeong shook his head.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang ominously rolled up his sleeves, but Mungyeong shook his head.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve been irritating me for a while now. Why do you keep telling me what to do in someone else’s house…?”
hunks.sol: “You’ve been getting on my nerves for a while now. Why do you keep meddling in other people’s business…?”

hunks.baseline: “Ah. I admit that.”
hunks.sol: “Ah. Fair point.”

hunks.baseline: *Damn it. So that’s what he meant.*
hunks.sol: *Goddamn it. So that’s what he meant.*

hunks.baseline: The moment Jeok Cheongang graciously stepped aside to let the next person take his turn, a pure-white silver line lashed out like a whip.
hunks.sol: The moment Jeok Cheongang graciously yielded his place to the next batter, a brilliant silver streak lashed out like a whip.

hunks.baseline: A chill ran down my spine, and cool air slipped through the gap in my severed clothes.
hunks.sol: A chill ran down my spine, and cool air slipped through my severed clothes.

hunks.baseline: I swallowed hard as I watched the upper half of my outfit split cleanly into two pieces, left and right.
hunks.sol: I swallowed hard as my shirt split cleanly into two halves, falling open to either side.

hunks.baseline: It had come down to a single hair’s breadth.
hunks.sol: It had missed by a hair’s breadth.

hunks.baseline: I stood there with my heart pounding as Mungyeong gazed at me impassively.
hunks.sol: I stood there with my heart pounding while Mungyeong gazed impassively at me.

hunks.baseline: “You could have dodged anyway.”
hunks.sol: “You could still have dodged.”

hunks.baseline: “What would have been the point? If I dodged, I’d just get hit twice instead of once. You weren’t planning to kill me anyway, were you?”
hunks.sol: “What would’ve been the point? If I dodged, I’d only get hit twice instead of once. You weren’t planning to kill me anyway, were you?”

hunks.baseline: “As expected, you’re strange. Strange enough to put me in a bad mood.”
hunks.sol: “As expected, you’re strange. Strange enough to make me uncomfortable.”

hunks.baseline: *Really? For someone who’s in a bad mood, your expression is pretty ambiguous.*
hunks.sol: *Really? For someone who’s uncomfortable, your expression is pretty hard to read.*

hunks.baseline: “Is that really something you can say after beating him like a dog while using martial arts?”
hunks.sol: “Is that really something you can say after beating him like a dog with martial arts?”

hunks.baseline: “Just standing here is making me feel my innate qi withering away. Enough. I didn’t come here for this sort of pointless exchange.”
hunks.sol: “I can feel my innate qi draining away just standing here. Enough. I didn’t come for this pointless exchange.”

hunks.baseline: “The boatman has regained consciousness. There are no unusual symptoms, and he understands everything clearly. The Dongting Fisherman, on the other hand… isn’t doing well.”
hunks.sol: “The boatman has regained consciousness. There are no unusual symptoms, and he’s sharp enough to understand what he’s told. The Dongting Fisherman, on the other hand… isn’t doing well.”

hunks.baseline: I nodded heavily.
hunks.sol: I nodded gravely.

hunks.baseline: The boatman had lost consciousness from a Pressure-Point Strike before he was properly exposed to Fear.
hunks.sol: The boatman had been knocked unconscious by a Pressure-Point Strike before he was properly exposed to Fear.

hunks.baseline: The Dongting Fisherman was the exact opposite. This was only my guess, but he had evidently encountered the Water God Dragon in Donghu Stronghold and been seriously exposed to Fear.
hunks.sol: The Dongting Fisherman was the exact opposite. This was only my guess, but he must have encountered the mutated Water God Dragon at Donghu Stronghold and been severely exposed to Fear.

hunks.baseline: “His limbs were crushed, and he has considerable internal injuries. He’s a Supreme Peak master, and the City Lord gave him an elixir, so he should recover quickly. But it seems that imugi really did a number on him.”
hunks.sol: “All four of his limbs were crushed, and his internal injuries are considerable. He’s a Supreme Peak master, and the City Lord gave him an elixir, so he should recover quickly. But that imugi must have gotten him good.”

hunks.baseline: I’d had plenty of opportunities to mention it during the past two days, but I had forgotten anyway.
hunks.sol: I’d had plenty of chances to mention it over the past two days, but I had forgotten anyway.

hunks.baseline: *I’d also been a little preoccupied.*
hunks.sol: *I was pretty preoccupied, to be fair.*

hunks.baseline: Of course, the reason for that was because I had been pursuing one person.
hunks.sol: Of course, that was because I had been tracking one person.
Honglan.

hunks.baseline: Honglan. The mastermind behind this entire incident.
hunks.sol: The culprit behind this entire incident.
